subject: Finlytics POC - Week 2 status and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Subject: Thanks for the call — Finlytics POC next steps

Hi Alice / Ravi —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary: Great discovery call — goal is to validate Redwood inference for Finlytics scoring pipeline (low-latency, <150ms p50 for 512 tokens; accuracy parity with current model on the scoring test set).

Success criteria (draft):
- Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for 512-token evaluations.
- Throughput: sustain 80 RPS with batching profile described in spreadsheet.
- Accuracy: <= 2% degradation on the scoring eval set vs. baseline.
- Integration: run sample inference via API with Finlytics staging data.

Owners / asks:
- Finlytics: provide sample test corpus, staging API credentials, and example inference calls (Alice, Ravi).
- Redwood: environment plan + POC guide, initial quantization profile, and SLO targets (Marcus / me).

Deliverables & timeline (suggested):
- By 2027-03-03: Finlytics shares staging creds and sample data (Alice).
- By 2027-03-05: Redwood spins up POC env and shares access + initial runbook (Marcus).
- Week of 2027-03-08: Run integration and baseline comparisons; first weekly status call on 2027-03-09.

See attached "POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx" with more detail. I attached the Redwood POC guide as well.

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for the standing weekly check (Tuesdays 9am PST).

Thanks —
Marissa

Notes on what I’ll run initially:
1) End-to-end inference latency (single request and 10qps sustained).

Quick weekly status — thanks for the catch-up earlier. 

Status: Marcus completed initial provisioning and ran baseline tests against the 2k sample. Early highlights: p50 latency ~120ms for 512-token profile; p95 ~310ms. Batch sizing still tuning, but we hit the 80 RPS throughput target in one config. Accuracy: initial model within 1.5% of baseline on the sample subset.

Open items (action owners):
- Finlytics (Alice): please upload the full 25k eval set to the Drive link this week so we can run the full accuracy sweep (due 2027-03-11).
- Redwood (Marcus): run full accuracy and cost estimation once full set available; share results and a recommended config (due 2027-03-12).
- FinOps (Ravi): any compliance/network approvals needed to keep the staging key beyond 2027-03-15?

Attaching the short runbook and the environment_access.txt that Marcus mentioned.

Next call: keep Tuesday 9am PST — next one 2027-03-16 but I’ll send a 1-off on 2027-03-12 if we have full results earlier.

Thanks —
